capabilities: Open files in new tabs by default
Focus existing tabs instead of duplicating them
Intercept file opens from File Explorer, Quick Switcher, links, bookmarks and API calls
Configure deduplication and execution delay in settings
extras: Desktop only, not available on mobile; requires Obsidian 1.8.9 or later.
intentEvidence: Smart Tabs is a fork of New Tab+ by Raphlette, licensed under MIT.
problem: Obsidian opens files in the current tab by default, so clicking through notes overwrites your workspace and opens duplicates.

relations.evidence: Smart Tabs is a fork of New Tab+ by Raphlette, licensed under MIT.

summary: Tab-behavior plugin that opens every file in a new tab by default and focuses the existing tab instead of creating duplicates.
